strings: m_c has had more issues with coordination than the other kits, often tripping over {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} paws. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} may have dyspraxia.
m_c has not developed motor skills as fast as the other kits. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} may have dyspraxia.
Much to m_c's frustration, {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} difficulties moving around likely won't go away as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/get/gets} older. m_c has dyspraxia.
When a nursery queen brings m_c to r_c's den, concerned about {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} difficulty developing motor skills, r_c says that m_c just has dyspraxia.
